build.buildCommand: cd shared && npm install && npm run build && cd ../backend && npm install --include=dev && npm run build

deploy.startCommand: ls -la && echo '---' && ls -la dist/ 2>/dev/null || echo 'no dist at root' && echo '---' && ls -la backend/dist/ 2>/dev/null || echo 'no backend/dist' && echo '---' && find . -name 'main.js' -type f 2>/dev/null | head -10 && echo '---' && node dist/backend/src/main.js
